notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1
notes.notes:
To keep the game fun and surprising for new players, I won't detail the specific anomalies. This way, new players can experience the game as intended without any spoilers.

[list]
[*] Improved visibility for 4 subtle anomalies (increased by 10-15%).
[*] Adjusted end-of-corridor conditions to be fairer when you're close to winning.
[*] Enhanced one very noticeable anomaly to improve its functionality.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with one anomaly not being removed.
[/list]

notes.title: 6th Floor - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Trapped on the 6th floor of a hotel, navigate through a maze of identical corridors. Sharpen your observation skills to spot anomalies guiding your way.

If you see something unusual, turn right; otherwise, go left. Be cautious, as a wrong turn means starting over. And watch out, some anomalies could lead to danger.

Your goal? Reaching the emergency exit, located beyond room 600. [b]Will you find your way out of the endless corridors?[/b]
